name: Kilo WireGuard Kubernetes Network
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source WireGuard-based encrypted Kubernetes multi-cloud/multi-cluster network overlay, VPN peer access and add-on mode; no software node or peer quota.
watch_out: Self-operate Kubernetes nodes and networking; WireGuard support, routable UDP endpoints, cluster infrastructure and bandwidth are required. Kilo does not include hosted VPN servers or cloud compute.
